messages.author: 58dec80924e95552
messages.subject: Data table sorting behavior shiny 0.9.1
parts:
Specs:
locally - shiny 0.9.1
open source server 1.0.0.42 with shiny 0.9.1
I use server.R and ui.R

When I run my application locally, the sorting in data table is rather surprising:
My numbers are formatted as strings with thousand's and million's separator (e.g. 1,123,456) and when I try sorting using data table column sort it does it correctly as numeric (e.g. 98,760, 11,647, 1,362...) which is already a surprising behavior to me, because I am not using any additional plugins for data table: 

server side:
output$table = renderDataTable(
  data_table()
  ,options=list(bAutoWidth=1,
                sInfoThousands=",",
                sScrollX=100,
                sScrollY=300, 
                bScrollCollapse=TRUE,
                bFilter=FALSE)
)

ui side:
dataTableOutput('table')

However, when I put my code on the shiny server (it is identical to locally run code) datatable now sorts as if the entries are strings (e.g. 98,760, 338, 1,362, 11,647...)

I am really confused about this behavior because it got me pretty excited when locally it was sorting that nicely. 

I was wondering if there is a bug or any explanation about this discrepancy would be nice.
If you need more information please let me know. 

Thank you,
Karolis
